headline: Jockey licensee Page Industries plans new manufacturing plant in India
hook: Capacity expansion on the cards for Page
summary: Page Industries, the exclusive licensee of the Jockey brand in India, is evaluating plans to set up a new manufacturing plant as part of its ongoing domestic expansion. The move aims to scale up production capacity to meet growing domestic demand for innerwear and athleisure apparel. Indian retail investors should note this capital expenditure as a sign of management's confidence in long-term volume growth within the discretionary consumer segment.
whats_next: Official announcement on plant location and capex outlay
why_it_matters: Capex plans signal strong long-term domestic volume growth for Page.
winners_losers: Page Industries gains / competitors face capacity pressure

headline: Nomura starts coverage on Page Industries with a buy rating
hook: Brokerage flags 24 percent upside for Jockey maker
summary: Japanese brokerage Nomura has initiated coverage on Page Industries, the exclusive licensee of Jockey in India, with a buy rating. The brokerage set a target price pointing to a potential 24 percent upside from recent trading levels. Page Industries operates in the premium innerwear and athleisure segment across the country. Retail investors holding the stock can assess the broker's growth assumptions regarding urban demand and distribution expansion.
whats_next: Page Industries upcoming quarterly earnings report
why_it_matters: Brokerage endorsement may influence institutional buying in the stock
winners_losers: Page Industries holders gain / competitors unaffected

headline: Page Industries sets record date for dividend
hook: November record date for Page Industries payout
summary: Page Industries Limited has informed the stock exchanges that November 18, 2026, will serve as the record date for its upcoming dividend. Shareholders listed as owners of the stock by this date will be eligible for the payout. For Indian retail investors holding the stock, this date determines dividend entitlement.
why_it_matters: Holders by November 18 get the dividend payout.

headline: Page Industries appoints Arjun Sunil Makhecha as Company Secretary and Compliance Officer
summary: Page Industries Limited has announced the appointment of Arjun Sunil Makhecha as its new Company Secretary and Compliance Officer, effective October 14, 2026. This routine corporate governance update involves a key compliance role within the listed innerwear manufacturer. Indian retail investors tracking the company note this as a standard administrative transition. Such appointments do not directly impact the operational earnings or stock valuation of the firm.
why_it_matters: Routine compliance change with no impact on stock price
